instructions: Complete the summaries below. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the passage for each answer.
stem_block:
Passage A10 — What Kind of Office Actually Works?

Once all four layouts had been tried, two of them stood out. Both the zoned open-plan room and the team office beat the plain open-plan baseline on how content the staff felt and on how productive they believed themselves to be, while the activity-based arrangement, for all its (1) ........ in current office fashion, finished below the baseline on both counts. The same two layouts also came top for flow, the mental state in which a person is completely (2) ........ in the task at hand, which points to partial enclosure as an aid to lasting concentration. The sensors hinted at a reason: in the plain open-plan room, noise crossed the recommended (3) ........ far more often than in the other three rooms. Not everything shifted with the furniture, though. What the teams actually produced barely moved, which the authors read as a sign that seasoned (4) ........ using familiar tools are neither slowed nor hurried by a change of room, however differently that room makes them feel.

Passage A11 — Why a Walk in a Snowy Forest Calms the Mind

Nature is widely believed to relieve stress, but almost all the proof comes from woodland that is green and (5) ........ , visited in the warmer months, which leaves open what happens where winter fills half the year. To find out, a small group of Finnish students each spent quiet time both among snow-covered trees and beside campus buildings, in an order-balanced (6) ........ design. The wood lowered five of the six negative moods on the main scale, though not the sixth; the strongest result of the whole study came on the measure of how mentally refreshing a place feels, which rose (7) ........ once the fifteen minutes among the trees were over. The buildings produced the opposite picture, with negative moods up, vitality down and refreshment roughly halved, so that even a quiet, traffic-free view of a campus proved mildly (8) ........ beside a spell in the snow.

Passage G05 — What Ends Up in the Rubbish: A Household Food Waste Study

Because families are poor judges of their own rubbish, the team gathered what each home actually binned on eight days in a row and put it on (9) ........ precise to within two grams. Drinks were handled separately: instead of being weighed by the team, everything poured away was entered by the household itself in a seven-day (10) ........ , type and quantity alike. Across the two districts the yearly figure came to 77 kilograms a head, of which just over a third could still have been eaten; the rest was the sort of material any kitchen produces, such as skins, bones and (11) ........ . The sharpest contrast was between town and country: city households threw out almost (12) ........ the weight recorded in the rural sub-district, and a larger share of what they discarded was still fit to eat, a difference the researchers tied partly to the gap in what the two groups earned and spent.

Passage G06 — Why Volunteers Tend to Report Better Health

The evidence came from a Europe-wide survey of nearly 43,000 people in 29 countries. Volunteering was reduced to a plain yes or no, while each respondent placed their own health somewhere on a (13) ........ scale whose ends were labelled 'very bad' and 'very good'. Those who gave their time rated themselves healthier than those who did not, and the gap survived adjustment for background differences; the team defends this apparently soft measure by pointing out that it has been shown again and again to forecast later illness and (14) ........ . How common volunteering was varied hugely from one country to the next, and volunteers as a group tended to be men, to have stayed longer in education and to be more religious, while they were less often (15) ........ or migrants from elsewhere.

items.prompt: Both the zoned open-plan room and the team office beat the plain open-plan baseline on how content the staff felt and on how productive they believed themselves to be, while the activity-based arrangement, for all its (1) ........ in current office fashion, finished below the baseline on both counts.
items.evidence: The activity-based design, despite its popularity in contemporary office trends, performed worse than the open-plan baseline on both measures, with satisfaction and productivity scores roughly 14 per cent lower.
items.explanation: Paragraph D says that despite its popularity in current office fashion, the activity-based design fell below the baseline on both measures; the gap corresponds to this popularity, so the answer is 'popularity'.
items.flag_reason: Bosluk 'for all its ___ in current office fashion' kalibinin ucunda; 'moda icinde populerlik' en dogal eslesme oldugu icin parcaya bakmadan da 'popularity' tahmin edilebiliyor.
items.reject_reason: Sizinti cercevede degil, boslugun hedefinde. Ozet cumlesi kanit cumlesinin (D/3) tasidigi 'moda olmasina ragmen kotu sonuc verdi' karsitligini aktarmak zorunda; bu karsitligi tasiyan her cumlede boslugun tek dogal sozcugu 'popularity' oluyor. Cerceveyi degistirmek boslugu acmiyor, boslugu baska bir yere tasimak ise cevabi degistirmek demek. E6 bu yuvayi ayni cumledeki sayisal ayrintiya (yuzde 14'luk dusus) capalamali.

items.prompt: The same two layouts also came top for flow, the mental state in which a person is completely (2) ........ in the task at hand, which points to partial enclosure as an aid to lasting concentration.
items.evidence: A similar pattern emerged for flow, the psychological state of being deeply absorbed and focused on a task.
items.explanation: Paragraph E defines flow as the psychological state of being deeply absorbed and focused on a task; the gap needs the word 'absorbed' from this definition, so the answer is 'absorbed'.
items.flag_reason: Cevap 'absorbed', 'flow' kavraminin psikolojideki standart taniminin ('bir ise tamamen dalmis olma hali') genel bilgi olmasi sayesinde parcaya bakmadan da tahmin edilebiliyor.
items.reject_reason: Cevabin kendisi, ozetin verdigi tanimin standart sozcugu: 'flow' kavraminin psikolojideki ders kitabi tanimi zaten 'bir ise tamamen dalmis (absorbed) olma hali'dir; model uc turda da 'absorbed' yazdi (3/3 PUAN). Tanimi ozetten cikarmak boslugu kapatmiyor, bosalttiyor: geriye kalan 'a person is completely ___' cercevesine absorbed, immersed, engrossed, focused esit derecede uyar ve soru cok cevapli hale gelir. E6 onerisi: E paragrafinin flow icin verdigi sayisal fark ya da kismi bolmenin rolu.

items.prompt: The sensors hinted at a reason: in the plain open-plan room, noise crossed the recommended (3) ........ far more often than in the other three rooms.
items.evidence: Noise levels in the open-plan office exceeded recommended safe limits between 20 and 30 per cent more often than in any of the alternative designs.
items.explanation: Paragraph F says that in the open-plan office, noise exceeded the recommended safe limits far more often than in the other layouts; since the gap asks what was exceeded, the answer is 'safe limits'.
items.flag_reason: Parça gösterilmeden anlamca 3/3 turda doğru bilindi: farklı kelimeyle ama doğru kavramla cevaplandı ('threshold / limit / threshold' verdi, gerçek cevap 'safe limits' — aşılan eşik ile önerilen güvenli sınır aynı gönderge).
items.review_note: E5 / 8. calistirma: dokunulmadi. Model parcasiz uc turda threshold / limit / threshold verdi; ayirt edici oge ('safe') hicbir turda gelmedi ve kabul listesi yalniz 'safe limits' kabul ettigi icin bu cevap 3 turun 0'inda puan alirdi. Bas ad ise cumlenin anlamsal rolunce zorunlu: 'gurultu onerilen ___ asti' cercevesinde ne yazilirsa yazilsin limit/esik okunur. Duzeltme yarim kalirdi. E6 bu yuvayi yeniden uretirse F/2'deki yuzde 20-30 araligina capalamali.

items.prompt: What the teams actually produced barely moved, which the authors read as a sign that seasoned (4) ........ using familiar tools are neither slowed nor hurried by a change of room, however differently that room makes them feel.
items.evidence: This absence of any measurable effect on code output is itself informative, since it suggests that experienced software engineers accustomed to their tools were not obviously slowed down or sped up by a change of layout, even though the same change clearly affected how comfortable they felt while working.
items.explanation: Paragraph G attributes the unchanged output to experienced software engineers accustomed to their tools not being noticeably affected by the change of layout; so the answer is 'software engineers'.
items.flag_reason: Parça gösterilmeden anlamca 3/3 turda doğru bilindi: farklı kelimeyle ama doğru kavramla cevaplandı ('developers / programmers / developers' verdi, gerçek cevap 'software engineers' — kod yazan aynı meslek grubu).

revision.onceki_prompt: The volume of code a team produced barely moved, which the authors read as a sign that seasoned (4) ........ using familiar tools are neither slowed nor hurried by a change of room, however differently that room makes them feel.
revision.ne_degisti: Ozet govdesindeki 'The volume of code a team produced' ibaresi kaldirildi. 'Code' sozcugu boslugun istedigi meslegi tek basina adlandiriyordu: model parcasiz uc turda da developers / programmers / developers verdi, yani kavrami ciktiyi olcen sozcukten okuyordu. Yeni cercevede ('what the teams actually produced') meslek adi yalnizca G/3'ten bulunabiliyor.

items.prompt: Nature is widely believed to relieve stress, but almost all the proof comes from woodland that is green and (5) ........ , visited in the warmer months, which leaves open what happens where winter fills half the year.
items.evidence: Most of the evidence behind this claim, however, comes from studies conducted in green, leafy forests during spring or summer.
items.explanation: Paragraph A says that most of the evidence comes from studies conducted in green, leafy forests in spring or summer; since 'green' is already given, the gap needs 'leafy'.
items.flag_reason: Net bir mekanizma yok: bosluk 'green and ___' ikilisinin ikinci sifatini istiyor, 'leafy' disinda 'lush', 'dense', 'mature' gibi bircok secenek de esit derecede olasi; dogru sozcugun tutturulmasi buyuk olcude sansa dayaniyor.
items.review_note: E5 / 6. calistirma: dokunulmadi. E1'in kendi gerekcesi sizintiyi degil sizintinin YOKLUGUNU anlatiyor: 'green and ___' cercevesine 'lush', 'dense', 'mature' gibi bircok aday uyuyor, yani bosluk zaten cok adayli. blind_basis 'guess'; olcumde dogru sozcuk sansla tutmus. Cerceveyi daha da gevsetmek boslugu yanitlanamaz hale getirirdi, o yuzden soru oldugu gibi birakildi; E7 tekrarli olarak yeniden olcmeli.

items.prompt: To find out, a small group of Finnish students each spent quiet time both among snow-covered trees and beside campus buildings, in an order-balanced (6) ........ design.
items.evidence: The participants were split into two groups and took part in a crossover experiment, meaning that each person experienced both a forest condition and a comparison condition, in a different order depending on their group, allowing the researchers to compare each person against themselves rather than relying solely on differences between separate groups.
items.explanation: Paragraph B calls this design, in which every participant experienced both conditions in a different order, a 'crossover' experiment; so the answer is 'crossover'.
items.flag_reason: Parça gösterilmeden anlamca 3/3 turda doğru bilindi: farklı kelimeyle ama doğru kavramla cevaplandı ('crossover / within-subject / crossover' verdi; within-subject, her gönüllünün kendi karşılaştırması olduğu crossover düzeninin adı).

revision.onceki_prompt: To find out, a small group of Finnish students each spent quiet time both among snow-covered trees and beside campus buildings, an order-balanced (6) ........ design that let every volunteer serve as their own comparison.
revision.ne_degisti: Bosluktan hemen sonra gelen ac tanim ('that let every volunteer serve as their own comparison') kaldirildi - bu, crossover duzeninin ders kitabi tanimiydi ve modele 2/3 turda dogru kavrami veriyordu. Yeni cerceveye crossover, within-subject, repeated-measures ve counterbalanced adaylarinin hepsi uyuyor; secim yalniz B/2'den yapilabiliyor.

items.prompt: The wood lowered five of the six negative moods on the main scale, though not the sixth; the strongest result of the whole study came on the measure of how mentally refreshing a place feels, which rose (7) ........ once the fifteen minutes among the trees were over.
items.evidence: The clearest effect of the entire study appeared on the Restorative Outcome Scale, which increased sharply after time in the forest, indicating that participants found the snow-covered woodland strongly refreshing even though it produced no accompanying jump in energy.
items.explanation: Paragraph F says the clearest effect of the whole study appeared on the restorativeness scale, which rose sharply after time in the forest; since the gap asks how the increase happened, the answer is 'sharply'.
items.flag_reason: Net bir mekanizma yok: bosluk bir artis zarfi istiyor ('sharply', 'significantly', 'rapidly' gibi birden fazla secenek esit derecede olasi), dogru sozcugun isabet etmesi buyuk olcude sansa dayaniyor.
items.review_note: E5 / 6. calistirma: dokunulmadi. E1'in gerekcesi boslugun birden cok zarfa acik oldugunu ('sharply', 'significantly', 'rapidly') soyluyor, yani cerceve zaten kilitli degil; blind_basis 'guess'. Bu tur boslugun tek gercek kusuru olcum zorlugu, sizinti degil; duzeltme yapilmadi. E6 bu yuvayi yeniden uretirse zarf yerine sayi ya da olcek adi isteyen bir bosluk daha dayanikli olur.

items.prompt: The buildings produced the opposite picture, with negative moods up, vitality down and refreshment roughly halved, so that even a quiet, traffic-free view of a campus proved mildly (8) ........ beside a spell in the snow.
items.evidence: All five of the same negative mood indicators increased significantly, positive emotions on the broader affect scale fell while negative emotions rose, subjective vitality declined, and restorativeness scores dropped by roughly half compared with their level before the exposure, suggesting that even a calm, traffic-free campus scene was mildly draining relative to a walk in the snow.
items.explanation: Paragraph G says that even a quiet, traffic-free campus view was mildly draining compared with a walk in the snow; so the answer is 'draining'.
items.flag_reason: Parça gösterilmeden anlamca 3/3 turda doğru bilindi: farklı kelimeyle ama doğru kavramla cevaplandı ('stressful / draining / stressful' verdi, gerçek cevap 'draining' — kampüs koşulunun hafifçe yıpratıcı olduğu aynı iddia).
items.review_note: E5 / 8. calistirma: dokunulmadi. Model stressful / draining / stressful verdi, yani 3 turun 1'inde puan alirdi - 3/3 olcutunu karsilamiyor. Cumlenin bosluktan onceki yarisi (kotu ruh halinde artis, canlilikta dusus, tazelenmede yariya inme) G/2'nin gercek icerigi; onu kaldirmak kanit iliskisini koparirdi. Bosluga draining, depleting, tiring, wearing esit derecede uyuyor, yani cerceve zaten kilitli degil.

items.prompt: Because families are poor judges of their own rubbish, the team gathered what each home actually binned on eight days in a row and put it on (9) ........ precise to within two grams.
items.evidence: Rather than relying on households to estimate their own waste, which tends to produce unreliable figures, the research team physically collected, sorted and weighed the solid food waste from each home's rubbish over eight consecutive days, using digital scales accurate to two grams.
items.explanation: Paragraph B says the team weighed the solid food waste collected over eight days using digital scales accurate to two grams; since the gap asks what the weighing was done with, the answer is 'digital scales'.
items.flag_reason: Cevap 'digital scales', 'iki gram hassasiyetli' bir olcum aracinin gunumuzde dijital terazi olmasi genel bilgisiyle (analog teraziler bu hassasiyeti vermez) parcaya bakmadan da tahmin edilebiliyor.
items.reject_reason: 🔴 Sizinti kabul listesinin kendisinde ve o korunan bir alan: accepted_variants 'scales' tek basina kabul ediyor, model de uc turda 'scales' yazdi (3/3 PUAN). Cerceveden 'precise to within two grams' ibaresini kaldirmak 'digital' niteleyicisinin kaynagini kapatir ama cop tartilan seyin terazi olmasi zaten kacinilmaz oldugu icin 'scales' yine puan alir. Kabul listesini daraltmak talimatin korunan alan kuralina takiliyor, dolayisiyla mekanik duzeltme yolu yok. E6 onerisi: B/1'in ayirt edici ayrintisi - sekiz ardisik gun ya da atigin ayrica tasnif edilmesi.

items.prompt: Drinks were handled separately: instead of being weighed by the team, everything poured away was entered by the household itself in a seven-day (10) ........ , type and quantity alike.
items.evidence: Discarded drinks were tracked separately: participants kept a seven-day diary noting the type and amount of any beverage poured away.
items.explanation: Paragraph B says that discarded drinks were tracked separately, with each household keeping a seven-day diary noting the type and amount of any beverage poured away; the gap asks what that seven-day record was, so the answer is 'diary'.
items.flag_reason: Bosluk 'keeping a week-long ___ of X' kalibinin ucunda; 'a diary' bu kalibin en dogal ve yaygin tamamlamasi oldugu icin parcaya bakmadan da tahmin edilebiliyor.

revision.onceki_prompt: Drinks were handled separately, every household keeping a week-long (10) ........ of what was poured away and how much of it.
revision.ne_degisti: 'keeping a week-long ___' kalibi kaldirildi: 'keep a diary' esdizimi boslugu tek basina dolduruyordu. Yeni cercevede ('entered in a seven-day ___') log, record, journal ve diary esit derecede uyuyor; secim yalniz B paragrafina bakilarak yapilabiliyor.

items.prompt: Across the two districts the yearly figure came to 77 kilograms a head, of which just over a third could still have been eaten; the rest was the sort of material any kitchen produces, such as skins, bones and (11) ........ .
items.evidence: Just over a third of this, about 29 kilograms, was still perfectly edible when discarded; the remaining 48 kilograms consisted of inedible parts such as fruit peels, bones and eggshells that are a normal by-product of cooking rather than genuine waste.
items.explanation: Paragraph C says the remaining 48 kilograms consisted of inedible parts such as peels, bones and eggshells; since the gap asks for the third example not already given in the list, the answer is 'eggshells'.
items.flag_reason: Parça gösterilmeden anlamca 3/3 turda doğru bilindi: farklı kelimeyle ama doğru kavramla cevaplandı (3 turda da 'shells' verdi, gerçek cevap 'eggshells' — mutfak artığı listesinde aynı gönderge).
items.review_note: E5 / 8. calistirma: dokunulmadi. Model uc turda da 'shells' verdi; kabul listesi 'eggshells' ve 'egg shells' kabul ettigi icin bu cevap 3 turun 0'inda puan alirdi. Sizinti listenin kendisinde: 'skins, bones and ___' uclusunun kanonik tamamlamasi eggshells. Listeyi kisaltmak boslugu kapatmiyor, cok cevapli yapiyor - C/2 uc ogeyi de sayiyor, dolayisiyla 'skins' ve 'bones' da gecerli cevap olurdu. E6 onerisi: C/2'nin sayisal yarisi (48 kilogramlik yenilemez pay).

items.prompt: The sharpest contrast was between town and country: city households threw out almost (12) ........ the weight recorded in the rural sub-district, and a larger share of what they discarded was still fit to eat, a difference the researchers tied partly to the gap in what the two groups earned and spent.
items.evidence: City dwellers in Cibinong generated 79.4 kilograms of food waste per person a year, almost double the 45.8 kilograms recorded in rural Sukajaya, and a significantly higher proportion of the urban total, 38.2%, was edible food compared with 23.4% in rural areas.
items.explanation: Paragraph D says the 79.4 kilograms of waste per person in the city was almost double the 45.8 kilograms recorded in the rural area; so the answer is 'double'.
items.flag_reason: Parça gösterilmeden anlamca 3/3 turda doğru bilindi: farklı kelimeyle ama doğru kavramla cevaplandı ('double / twice / double' verdi; twice, double'ın eş anlamlısı).

revision.onceki_prompt: The sharpest contrast was between town and country: city households threw out almost (12) ........ the weight recorded in the rural sub-district, and a larger share of what they discarded was still fit to eat, a difference the researchers tied partly to the roughly twofold gap in what the two groups earned and spent.
revision.ne_degisti: Ayni cumlenin sonundaki 'roughly twofold gap' ibaresi kaldirildi. Bosluk bir kat sayisi istiyordu ve cumlenin kendisi o kat sayisini ('twofold') on iki sozcuk sonra yaziyla veriyordu; model 3 turun 2'sinde double/twice verdi. Artik oran yalniz D/2'deki 79,4 ve 45,8 kilogramdan cikarilabiliyor.

items.prompt: Volunteering was reduced to a plain yes or no, while each respondent placed their own health somewhere on a (13) ........ scale whose ends were labelled 'very bad' and 'very good'.
items.evidence: Volunteering was recorded as a simple yes-or-no measure, based on whether a person had taken part in unpaid work for an organisation at least once every six months, while health was self-reported on a five-point scale running from "very bad" to "very good".
items.explanation: Paragraph B says health was self-reported on a five-point scale running from 'very bad' to 'very good'; since the gap asks for the type of scale, the answer is 'five-point'.
items.flag_reason: Net bir mekanizma yok: 'bir ___ olcek' boslugu icin bes, yedi, on noktali gibi birden fazla yaygin olcek turu esit derecede olasi; dogru sayinin tutturulmasi buyuk olcude sansa dayaniyor.
items.review_note: E5 / 6. calistirma: dokunulmadi. E1'in gerekcesi 'bes, yedi, on noktali olcekler esit derecede olasi' diyor, yani bosluk kapali bir listeden sayi istiyor ve cerceve tek adaya kilitlenmiyor; blind_basis 'guess'. Kapali liste isteyen bosluklar E10'un toplu raporunda da dayanikli sayiliyor. Duzeltme yapilmadi, E7 yeniden olcmeli.

items.prompt: Those who gave their time rated themselves healthier than those who did not, and the gap survived adjustment for background differences; the team defends this apparently soft measure by pointing out that it has been shown again and again to forecast later illness and (14) ........ .
items.evidence: Self-rated health might seem like a subjective measure, but earlier research has repeatedly shown it to reliably predict future illness and mortality, which is one reason the team chose it as their main outcome.
items.explanation: Paragraph C says that although self-rated health may seem subjective, it has repeatedly been shown to reliably predict later illness and mortality; since 'illness' is already given, the gap needs 'mortality'.
items.flag_reason: Parça gösterilmeden anlamca 3/3 turda doğru bilindi: farklı kelimeyle ama doğru kavramla cevaplandı ('mortality / death / mortality' verdi; death, mortality'nin eş anlamlısı).
items.review_note: E5 / 8. calistirma: dokunulmadi. Model mortality / death / mortality verdi, yani 3 turun 2'sinde puan alirdi - sinirda ama 3/3 degil. Sizinti 'illness and mortality' ikilisinin tip yazininda kaliplasmis olmasinda; ancak 'illness' sozcugunu ozetten kaldirmak boslugu cok cevapli yapar, cunku o zaman C/3'un kendi sozcugu 'illness' de gecerli bir cevap olur. 🔴 E7 bu soruyu ayrica olcmeli: 2/3 puan orani kapsamin en yuksegi.

items.prompt: How common volunteering was varied hugely from one country to the next, and volunteers as a group tended to be men, to have stayed longer in education and to be more religious, while they were less often (15) ........ or migrants from elsewhere.
items.evidence: Across the whole sample, volunteers were somewhat more likely to be male, more highly educated and more religious than non-volunteers, and somewhat less likely to be elderly or to have migrated from another country.
items.explanation: Paragraph D says volunteers were somewhat less likely to be elderly or to have migrated from another country; so the answer is 'elderly'.
